sn45.50-54:1.4: “Enthusiasm” (_chanda_) is the desire to achieve the wholesome, especially liberation from transmigration. It is one of the bases of psychic power (SN 51).
sn45.50-54:1.5: “Accomplishment in self-development” (_attasampadā_) is found only here and in parallel passages. In similar contexts we find _cittasampadā_ (“accomplishment in mental development”), i.e. _samādhi_ ([an3.117:4.3]()). Hence the commentary glosses _attā_ with _citta_ here.
sn45.50-54:1.6: Normally one “accomplished in view” is a stream-enterer ([sn13.10:3.1]()).
